review.notes: Solo original-source and native-frame visual review accepted. Reciprocal 12-pose run; physical two-handed melee raise/jab/recovery; corrected knee/chest hit recoil with stable short pipe; held crouched guard ending before unwanted firing; left spare-needle support gesture and return; corrected grounded side-collapse/final corpse. Ranged uses original loading/aim, one corrected release, then original empty-pipe lowering/reload: detached generated flight is separated only across verified empty columns because runtime owns projectile flight. Reject malformed melee settling50-52 and entire bad melee retry, unsafe orange death plate, bad original hit and repeated ranged shot. Review retained source pixels and anatomical scale; no duplicate, reversed, interpolated or warped padding. Windows Godot candidate955 and reflected955 checks passed.
